name: Hermes Obsidian Bridge
short_desc: OpenAI-compatible proxy in front of Hermes api_server with session continuity and vault RAG
author: cori
description: Thin OpenAI-compatible proxy in front of the Hermes api_server. Adds session continuity (X-Session-Id), vault RAG via the Obsidian Local REST API (X-Obsidian-Note-Path), and automatic cost routing between a cheap and strong model based on prompt length. Wire it into any OpenAI-compatible Obsidian plugin (Copilot for Obsidian, Text Generator, Local GPT) for in-note chat with the full Hermes agent. Image: forge.407.lol/cori/hermes-obsidian-bridge:sha-7139662d. Source: https://github.com/cori/hermes-obsidian-bridge.

form_fields.label: Hermes API Server Key
form_fields.hint: Bearer token for the Hermes api_server. Must match the API_SERVER_KEY on the gateway host. Required.

form_fields.label: Hermes api_server URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of the Hermes api_server (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8642). Used by the bridge for chat and model listing. host.docker.internal works for Docker Desktop; on Linux Runtipi, use the host IP.

form_fields.label: Obsidian Local REST API URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API plugin. Default 27123. On Tailscale setups, use the Mac's Tailscale IP.

form_fields.label: Obsidian Local REST API Key
form_fields.hint: API key from the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Local REST API → API Key). Leave empty if the plugin is configured for no auth on a trusted network.

form_fields.label: Cheap Model
form_fields.hint: Model id to route short prompts to. Default uses umans-flash to burn expiring credits.

form_fields.label: Strong Model
form_fields.hint: Model id to route longer prompts to.

form_fields.label: Cheap Model Char Threshold
form_fields.hint: Prompts shorter than this (in characters) go to CHEAP_MODEL. Set to a large number to disable cheap-routing entirely.

form_fields.label: Enable Vault RAG
form_fields.hint: Set to 'true' to pre-fetch the current note + today's daily + this week's review from Obsidian and prepend as context. Set to 'false' to disable.
